verdict.rationale: Intel's own marketing claims the chip handles long edits and heavy exports even unplugged, and cites intelligent power management and power efficiency, so the vendor does claim this capability. However, these are vague marketing statements with no documented power envelope and no sustained-load data. Missing for 10: documented power envelopes (TDP/PL1/PL2 figures), independent or hands-on sustained-render throttling tests, and measured performance-per-watt data.

support.subject: As a creator, long renders and exports don't throttle away — documented power envelopes and independent testing showing strong sustained performance per watt

citations.quote: Tackle 3D models, long edits, and heavy exports with Intel® Arc™ graphics, even unplugged and on-the-go.
Dedicated low-power AI engines and intelligent power management drive smart performance, even when you leave the charger behind.
Smart power efficiency, so your battery lasts longer and performs unplugged.
